INSERT INTO account_research_pipeline_runs (
            organization_id,
            account_id,
            researched_account_id,
            trigger,
            status,
            current_stage,
            started_at,
            finished_at,
            error_code,
            error_message
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'ENRICH_EXECUTION',
            'FAILED',
            'SNAPSHOT_GENERATION',
            now() - interval '5 minutes',
            now() - interval '1 minute',
            'brief_generation_failed',
            'brief generation failed'
         )
